settings.text: A structured ivory canvas mini tote finished with a hand-tied ribbon bow and warm gold hardware. The little carryall that makes a linen dress, a boat day, or a Saturday market run feel considered.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Made for the woman who wants her everyday bag to feel like an occasion, the Bow Tote is built from structured, reinforced cotton canvas and finished with a signature ribbon bow threaded through four gold-tone grommets. The body holds its shape from the morning market to an evening out, while the short rolled handles sit easily in the hand or over the arm. Inside, a printed lining with an open pocket and a zippered pocket keeps the small things findable. Loosen the bow, re-tie it, or swap the mood entirely — it's the rare little tote that reads finished with nothing else added.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Exterior: Reinforced heavyweight cotton canvas.
Bow & Trim: Woven fabric ribbon with gold-tone grommets, feet and hardware.
Interior: Fully lined and reinforced, with one open pocket and one zippered pocket.

Care: Spot clean with a soft, damp cloth and mild soap; air dry away from direct heat. Keep the gold-tone hardware dry and buff gently with a soft cloth. Avoid prolonged moisture — canvas is durable but not waterproof.

settings.title: Dimensions & Fit
settings.content:
Height: 8.5"  |  Width: 14.75" at top, 10.75" at base  |  Depth: 5.5"  |  Handle Drop: 5.5"

What it fits: phone, cardholder or slim wallet, sunglasses, keys, lip balm and your daily essentials.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

New colors release in limited quantities — sold-out shades may take 4 to 8 weeks to restock.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.heading: Customize Your Bow Tote
settings.intro: Add an organizer, charm, or scarf to complete your bag — all designed to match.

settings.headline: Tied by Hand, Made to Move
settings.body:
Watch how the Bow Tote moves through the day. The reinforced canvas holds a structured shape whether the bag is full or empty, and the ribbon bow catches the light with every step. It's the kind of little bag that draws a second look — and a question about where you found it.

A coastal classic, finished with a bow. Refined enough for evening, easy enough for every day.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Structured Cotton Canvas
settings.body: Heavyweight canvas with a fully reinforced body, so it stands on its own — on the table, the sand, or the passenger seat.

settings.headline: Warm Gold-Tone Fittings
settings.body: Four gold-tone grommets and protective base feet, chosen to warm with wear instead of flaking.

settings.headline: Tie It, Re-Tie It
settings.body: The ribbon threads through the front grommets and ties in a soft bow — loosen it, cinch it, or change the mood entirely.

settings.headline: Small outside, roomy where it counts
settings.body: Phone, sunglasses, cardholder, keys and a lip balm slip in easily — with an open pocket for the things you reach for most.

settings.headline: One open pocket, one zip pocket
settings.body: A zippered interior pocket keeps cards and cash secure while the open pocket holds the essentials.

settings.headline: Gold feet that keep it off the ground
settings.body: Protective gold-tone feet lift the canvas base off café floors, boat decks, and beach sand.

settings.headline: Lined and reinforced, inside and out
settings.body: A pretty printed lining and reinforced interior mean it looks as considered open as it does closed.

Structured canvas that stands on its own

settings.headline: The Bag That Packs Its Own Charm
settings.body:
No styling required. The bow does the work — knot it once and the Bow Tote reads finished from the marina to the market. We took the structured mini-tote silhouette and gave it a ribbon bow through gold grommets, so the little bag you carry feels like a piece people ask about.

Released in limited colors each season, and designed to be the one you reach for long after summer ends.

settings.headline: Two years covered. Lifetime in our shop.
settings.body: Two-year warranty on materials and stitching. After that, we repair anything for the cost of materials. Send it back. Get it back better than you sent it.
